mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through the valuation channel.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% and rises by more than 0.25 percentage points in the prior month, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls indicates a strong labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through the earnings channel.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by high consumer spending, a sustained increase in residential construction permits signals robust household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is rising and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production indicates robust manufacturing output that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% and continues to decline for two consecutive months, it signals an overheating labor market that may trigger inflationary pressures and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0% and UNRATE declines > 0.1pp in 2 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction permits and retail sales indicates strong consumer demand that boosts corporate sales and earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through the revenue channel.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a sustained increase in the consumer price index above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that leads to further rate hikes, depressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 3.0% and the economy is in a monetary tightening cycle, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
